findlay-market.mobility.4: Pick up is available Tuesday through Friday. When finalizing your order, you will select your pickup date & time. The windows are from 3-4pm, 4-5pm, and 5-6pm. You will receive a notification when your order is ready on the day of your selected pickup with instructions to park under The Shed in the North parking lot . There are reserved parking spaces for pickup orders. Call (513) 744-8010 when you arrive and your order will be brought out to your vehicle.
findlay-market.cognitive.2: The Findlay Market Shopping App operates on a Tuesday-Friday fulfillment schedule. Orders can be placed as late as 5pm the night before you'd like your order, and are available for local delivery or pickup at Findlay Market between 4pm-7pm on your selected day of fulfillment.
findlay-market.chronic.3: Is contactless delivery available? Yes! When we contact you on the day of your order, let us know that you would prefer contactless delivery.

findlay-market.chronic.4: Please be advised that even though your order may not contain common allergen items, many of our orders that are packed in the same space could contain milk, eggs, wheat, soybean, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, and/or peanuts.
findlay-market.cognitive.3: Shop on the Findlay Market Shopping App & Get FREE Delivery & NO Service Fees if you utilize SNAP/EBT Benefits HOW? During checkout, the delivery and service fees will be visible in carts, but these fees will be waived at the time of pickup or delivery. An EBT card must be used for at least a portion of the order to have the fees waived. Orders eligible for the waiver must contain SNAP-eligible products
